leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Write a functional HttpInterceptorFn that intercepts all outgoing requests and catches errors using catchError
Classify HTTP errors by status code (401 → redirect to login, 403 → forbidden page, 5xx → retry prompt) inside the interceptor
Push classified errors to an ErrorStateService with a BehaviorSubject, exposing a public error$ observable
Re-throw the original error after pushing it to the service so individual components can still handle errors locally if needed
Build an ErrorBannerComponent that subscribes to error$ via async pipe and renders the banner with an actionable message
Implement a dismiss() method and auto-clear the error state after a successful subsequent request to avoid stale banners
Test the interceptor using HttpClientTestingModule by flushing error responses and asserting that the ErrorStateService emits the correct error
